newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: INFLATION EXPECTED AT 8.5 TO 11.5 PCT.
newsitem.headline: INFLATION EXPECTED AT 8.5 TO 11.5 PCT.

text.p: Lithuanian annual inflation is expected to be 8.5 percent to 11.5 percent in 1997, the government press office said on Wednesday.

"It is forecast that in 1997 inflation may be 8.5 percent but if energy prices, principally heating energy, increase to market prices, the inflation this year may be 11.5 percent," the government office said in a statement.
The statement said the forecasts were based on statistics office information.
It also forecast that inflation in March and April will be 0.5 percent on a monthly basis and that in May it would 0.6 percent.
The office said that the statistics office made the forecasts based on the consumer price index and its relation to other macroeconomic data in 1994 and 1995.
It did not give a reason for the unexpected forecasts.
